title: Steel plate smelted by hand at Central Nexus from iron ore bought there at 1 cr, kept in the pilot's storage for the reserve (Logistics' haulers, standing work at home)
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-24 07:32 UTC (orders ENT-085 block APOLLO: no hauler waits docked, steel on iron; P2; rules F8, F23, F24, F36). At 07:30 UTC 13 haulers waited docked at Nexus Prime at the end of the paid Sol loop. Central Nexus asks 1 cr for iron ore x 24,400 (depth 132,696, table books 07:31 UTC): 10 ore a plate by hand is 10 cr a plate against the 18 cr plate ask, and the reserve is short of 36,466 steel plate (tool needs action=items 07:27 UTC). Each run: five loads of 65 ore bought and stored, then basic_iron_smelting in halving sizes from storage (stops copied from craft-steel-logistics-central-nexus), the plate stored: docked, no fuel, crafting XP. A circuit that buys and crafts is craft work (workclass.py), open to haulers. Standing; the reserve gate (F36) closes it at the steel max; requires.ask keeps it to the 1 cr ask. max_ships 3 for the first runs (F37). 2026-11-24 07:39 UTC (Apollo): the first three runs: 12/12 stops in 5 min, 325 iron bought at 1 cr, 32 of 32 steel plate made and stored, -325 cr each (RESULT lines 07:37 to 07:39 UTC). max_ships 3 -> 15: 13 haulers waited at Nexus Prime. The 1 cr ask held 24,400 units at 07:31 UTC, about 75 runs; requires.ask closes the route when it is gone. 2026-11-24 07:41 UTC (Apollo): max_ships 15 -> 25 (10 more waited at Nexus Prime, why_closed.py: max_ships reached) and the ask gate 1 -> 2 cr (buy limit 3): the 1 cr ask carries about 75 runs, the book's depth was 132,696 units at 07:31 UTC; at 2 cr a plate costs 20 cr of ore.
